description: Voice design in English or Chinese: describe the voice ("Hearty, jovial tavern owner, loud and welcoming, slightly gruff") and what it says. No reference clip. Every take is a new voice drawn from the description, so keep the seed fixed to keep a voice. Experimental.
cpuNote: Slow on the CPU: expect several times longer than the audio.

settings.label: Voice description
settings.description: Emotion, speed, pitch and character of the voice, in English or Chinese. Required.

settings.label: Temperature
settings.description: This model is sensitive to its sampling settings; the defaults are upstream's.

settings.label: Stop temperature
settings.description: How loosely the model decides when to stop. Upstream's 1.5 ends some takes in the middle of the text; 1.0 and lower didn't.
